scientific_integrity: The prior exact renewal expression is credited to Radice. The new claim is a strict convexity lemma and its three-case asymptotic global optimization consequence; numerical evidence supplements, but does not replace, analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive tumble rate, symmetric launch and relaunch directions, memoryless alarms, deterministic constant-speed returns, and no resetting or capture during return. Asymptotics are for return speed approaching zero and do not classify every finite-speed optimum. The underlying exact mean first passage time is an established previously published formula; generalizations and independent priority remain unverified.
title: A sharp slow-return criticality law for persistent telegraphic search
